label_descriptions.long-flag-space-value: Long flags in the form '--name value' (separate tokens) parse value as the flag's value. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising space-separated long flag values.
label_descriptions.long-flag-equals-value: Long flags in the form '--name=value' (single token) parse value as the flag's value. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising equals-separated long flag values.
label_descriptions.short-flag: Short flags '-x value' parse with value as a string, or set the flag boolean if no value follows. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising short-flag handling.
label_descriptions.combined-short-flags: Combined short flags '-xyz' set each of x, y, z as boolean true. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising combined short flags.
label_descriptions.positional-args: Tokens that do not start with a dash are positional arguments and appear in the positional array in order. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising positional arg collection.
label_descriptions.boolean-long-flag: A long flag with no value (next token is a flag or end of input) is captured as boolean true. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising boolean long-flag behavior.
label_descriptions.repeated-long-flag: When a long flag appears multiple times, values collect into an array. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising repeated-flag collection.
label_descriptions.empty-input: Empty argv array returns an empty flags object and an empty positional array. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising empty input.
